ActionItem.description: One Action Item as /api/actions and Today's "Needs you" list return it (the OpenAPI shape).
ActionItem.title: ActionItem

Advice.description: GET /api/advise: storage and run advice plus every recommendation (storage first).
Advice.title: Advice

PolicyItem.description: A locked row: a rule the code enforces whatever the config says.
PolicyItem.title: PolicyItem

Reason.description:
Why a job needs a human. `code`: stable id the UI may map; `text`: a human sentence (no commands, no internal
ids); `detail`: the raw technical text behind it (file values, CLI hints), for a Details disclosure.
Reason.title: Reason

StorageSnapshot.description: One line of the snapshots log (appended after each run / prune; older lines may lack keys).
StorageSnapshot.title: StorageSnapshot

StorageView.description: GET /api/storage: bytes per category, the disk, the snapshot history and the advisor config.
StorageView.title: StorageView
